summary: Large language models (LLMs), and the agents built on top of them, are now benchmarked heavily on whether they can finish a task -- fix a bug, drive a browser, operate a GUI. A complementary social ability, namely how well a model understands and forecasts the way real social events unfold, has barely been measured. We introduce SocietyBench, an end-to-end benchmark that takes a one-line event topic, collects Web news and social-media posts across five platforms, distills them into a date-indexed timeline that keeps factual events and a public-opinion layer separate, and then turns every cutoff date on that timeline into an audited bank of forecasting questions. Questions are scored on two orthogonal 100-point axes: probability calibration and temporal accuracy. Before any model sees a timeline, a three-phase procedure replaces every named entity and shifts every date by a per-event constant, turning a real arc into a counterfactual social world -- structurally identical to what happened, but stripped of the surface labels a model could match against pre-training memory. On five heterogeneous events and 125 prediction points in Chinese and English editions, the strongest of six frontier LLMs reaches only 75.0 out of 100, against a trivial anchor of 50. The two axes come apart: a model can be calibration-strong but time-weak, or the reverse. Three agent frameworks built on a shared base model fail to improve on that base, and two model-free heuristics trail every LLM. Per-event gaps reach 21.4 points on a single axis, which is our main argument for evaluating on several events rather than one. All anonymized timelines, question banks, ground truth, and scoring code are released.
title: SocietyBench: Forecasting Counterfactual Social-World Evolution
title_translated: SocietyBench：预测反事实社会世界演化
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）及其构建的智能体目前主要通过能否完成任务来评估——如修复漏洞、操作浏览器或GUI。然而，另一种互补的社会能力，即模型对真实社会事件发展过程的理解与预测能力，却几乎未被测量。我们提出了SocietyBench，一个端到端的基准测试：以一句话事件主题为输入，跨五个平台收集网络新闻和社交媒体帖子，将其提炼为按日期索引的时间线，区分事实事件层与公众意见层，并将时间线上每个截止日期转化为经过审计的预测问题库。问题在两个正交的100分轴上评分：概率校准性和时间准确性。在任何模型看到时间线之前，通过三阶段流程对每个命名实体进行替换并统一偏移日期，将真实事件转化为反事实社会世界——结构上与实际发生一致，但去除了模型可通过预训练记忆匹配的表面标签。在五个异构事件和中英文版共125个预测点上，六种前沿LLM中的最强者仅达到75.0分（满分100），远低于50分的基线水平。两个评分维度可分离：模型可能校准性强但时间弱，或反之。基于同一基础模型构建的三种智能体框架未能超越基础模型，两种无模型启发式方法也落后于所有LLM。单事件差距可达21.4分，这正是我们主张在多个事件上评估而非单一事件的主要依据。所有匿名化时间线、问题库、真实答案及评分代码均已公开。

summary: Benchmarks that measure the forecasting ability of large language models are almost always retrospective: the event has happened, the answer is somewhere on the Web, and the evaluation must defend itself against memorisation. We report the opposite design. Over the 39 days of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, six frontier LLMs -- all with extended thinking and native server-side web search -- were asked before every kickoff, one match at a time, to fill in a seven-market prediction card for all 104 matches, plus 12 group winners and a pre-tournament outright pool; no answer existed when the question was asked, so the evaluation is leakage-free by construction rather than by filtering, and the frozen archive holds 4,494 scored predictions. What the tournament establishes is a set of behaviours the six systems share. On match outcome they average 63.9%, level with backing the bookmaker's favourite -- which is in fact what they usually do. They agree with one another far more often than they are right, so a majority vote adds nothing. They under-commit to draws and to goals, and crowd their scoreline picks onto a single prototypical result. Accuracy tracks how lopsided a fixture is rather than how much is known about it: it collapses in the closest ties, where the dossiers are richest, while questions about the tournament as a whole are answered well. On this task the current generation of frontier systems is not sharply differentiated: the standings hold up at the top and the bottom across the run and churn in the middle, and the margins stay narrow throughout. The briefing dossiers, fixtures and official results are released as a benchmark, together with the scoring code.
title: WorldCup Arena: Prospective, Leakage-Free Evaluation of Frontier LLMs on a Live Tournament
title_translated: WorldCup Arena：对前沿LLM在实时世界杯赛事中的前瞻性、无泄漏评估
summary_translated: 衡量大型语言模型预测能力的基准测试几乎都是回顾性的：事件已发生，答案存在于网络中，评估必须防范记忆泄露。我们报告了一种相反的设计。在2026年国际足联世界杯的39天期间，六种前沿LLM——均具备扩展思维能力和原生服务端网页搜索功能——在每场比赛开赛前逐场被要求填写包含104场比赛、12支小组出线队以及赛前总胜者池的七市场预测卡；提问时答案尚不存在，因此评估从构造上就是无泄漏的，而非通过过滤实现。冻结的档案库包含4,494条已评分预测。该赛事揭示了六个系统共享的一系列行为模式。在比赛结果预测上，平均准确率为63.9%，与投注庄家热门选项持平——而这正是它们通常所做。它们彼此之间的一致性远高于正确率，因此多数投票并无增益。它们对平局和进球数的预测存在低估倾向，且将得分预测集中于单一典型结果。准确率反映的是对阵的悬殊程度，而非知识掌握程度：在最接近的比赛中，当情报资料最丰富时，准确率反而下降；而关于整个赛事的问题则回答得较好。在此任务上，当前一代前沿系统并未表现出显著差异：排名在顶部和底部保持稳定，中间部分波动频繁，整体差距始终较小。赛事简报资料、赛程表和官方结果已作为基准发布，附带评分代码。

summary: Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) enables LLMs to solve complex tasks through iterative tool interactions. However, existing reinforcement learning methods often rely on trajectory-level supervision, limiting fine-grained credit assignment in long-horizon TIR scenarios. On-policy self-distillation offers denser signals through teacher branches with privileged context, but existing approaches typically derive such context from ground-truth answers or retrieved skills, which may not reflect the states actually visited by the agent. Moreover, token-level supervision fails to capture the turn-level structure of tool interactions. To address this, we propose TurnSight, a turn-level hindsight self-distillation framework that derives supervision directly from execution-conditioned hindsight. It then constructs multiple hindsight views with different lookahead horizons and selects reliable supervision through cross-horizon directional agreement. Finally, the selected hindsight signal is normalized across sibling rollouts and used to adaptively modulate RL advantages while preserving their original optimization direction. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of TurnSight. Our codes are available at https://github.com/quchangle1/TurnSight.
title: TurnSight: Turn-Level Hindsight Self-Distillation for Tool-Integrated Reasoning
title_translated: TurnSight：面向工具集成推理的回合级事后自蒸馏
summary_translated: 工具集成推理（TIR）使大语言模型通过迭代工具交互解决复杂任务。然而，现有强化学习方法常依赖轨迹级监督，在长周期TIR场景中限制了细粒度信用分配。在线策略自蒸馏通过带有特权上下文的教师分支提供更密集信号，但现有方法通常从真实答案或检索到的技能中推导上下文，这些可能无法反映智能体实际访问的状态。此外，标记级监督无法捕捉工具交互的回合级结构。为此，我们提出TurnSight，一种基于执行条件事后视角的回合级自蒸馏框架。它直接从执行条件事后视角获取监督信号，构建具有不同前瞻视野的多个事后视图，并通过跨视野方向一致性选择可靠监督。最后，将选定的事后信号在兄弟回放中归一化，并用于自适应调节强化学习优势，同时保留其原始优化方向。在三个基准上的大量实验验证了TurnSight的有效性。代码已开源：https://github.com/quchangle1/TurnSight。

summary: Recursive self-improvement requires agents to turn accumulated experience into better future behavior. Personal AI agents offer a concrete setting for studying this capability because they retain preferences, task histories, tool routines, and learned skills across sessions. Yet whether retained experience actually improves them over time has not been systematically tested. We introduce PAST-Bench, a benchmark designed to isolate this question. Each agent runs through ordered sequences of fresh-session tasks under matched conditions that turn retained experience on and off. It spans 26 scenarios and 204 episodes across memory, procedural reuse, information gathering, and update. We report both later-task gains and whether those gains follow the intended save, retrieve, and update pathway. Across seven base models and four agent frameworks, improvement is real but uneven across capabilities. Agents with the same headline gain can differ markedly in whether that gain is supported by evidence of the intended pathway. Guided by these findings, we develop Hermes+, which extends Hermes with five targeted interventions across stages of the agent loop. Hermes+ raises the average gain from retained experience and provides clearer pathway evidence, with its strongest improvement on tasks requiring outdated state to be replaced, although the effect remains capability- and model-dependent. Together, PAST-Bench and Hermes+ provide an evaluation and diagnostic foundation for studying how persistent agents can progress from retaining experience to systematically improving through it. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/PAST-Bench
title: PAST-Bench: Benchmarking the Foundations of Recursive Self-Improvement in Personal Agents
title_translated: PAST-Bench：个人智能体递归自我改进基础能力的基准测试
summary_translated: 递归自我改进要求智能体将积累的经验转化为未来更好的行为。个人AI智能体提供了研究这一能力的具体场景，因为它们能在会话间保留偏好、任务历史、工具流程和学习技能。然而，这种保留经验是否真的能随时间提升智能体性能，尚未得到系统性检验。我们提出PAST-Bench，一个旨在隔离该问题的基准测试。每个智能体在匹配条件下运行一系列新会话任务，通过开启或关闭保留经验来对比表现。该基准涵盖26种情景和204个episode，覆盖记忆、程序复用、信息获取和更新等维度。我们报告了后期任务的提升效果，以及这些提升是否遵循预期的保存、检索和更新路径。在七种基础模型和四种智能体框架中，改进确实存在，但不同能力间差异明显。相同标题提升的智能体在是否支持预期路径证据方面可能截然不同。基于这些发现，我们开发了Hermes+，在Hermes基础上引入五个针对智能体循环各阶段的干预措施。Hermes+提升了保留经验带来的平均收益，并提供了更清晰的路径证据，尤其在需要替换过时状态的任务上效果显著，尽管影响仍取决于具体能力与模型。PAST-Bench与Hermes+共同为研究持久智能体如何从经验保留走向系统性改进提供了评估与诊断基础。代码：https://github.com/Gen-Verse/PAST-Bench

summary: We identify a previously overlooked failure mode of ALiBi positional encoding: its linear bias scaling underflows floating-point precision, which zeroes out a large fraction of attention weights and renders the affected attention heads partially blind. We analyze this failure mode, characterize its impact, and examine four mitigation strategies. We further demonstrate its occurrence in state-of-the-art pretrained models based on ALiBi. Comprehensive pretraining experiments with 148M-parameter decoder models help us to disentangle its effects from out-of-context degradation. We find that ALiBi's failure mode can substantially impair token retrieval while having only a minor effect on standard decoder benchmarks. We propose four training-time mitigation strategies and evaluate them individually and in combinations, finding that log-scaled distances yield the most consistent improvements in passkey retrieval. Despite this problem, default ALiBi slopes remain a surprisingly strong baseline, particularly for needle-in-a-haystack retrieval. Based on these findings we provide concrete recommendations on how to train models with ALiBi.
title: When Attention Goes Blind: Numerical Failure in ALiBi Positional Encodings
title_translated: 当注意力失明时：ALiBi位置编码中的数值失败
summary_translated: 我们识别出ALiBi位置编码中一种此前被忽视的失效模式：其线性偏置缩放会超出浮点精度范围，导致大量注意力权重归零，使受影响的注意力头部分失明。我们分析了这一失效模式，刻画其影响，并考察了四种缓解策略。进一步证明该问题出现在基于ALiBi的先进预训练模型中。通过对148M参数解码器模型进行全面预训练实验，我们得以将该效应与上下文外退化现象区分开来。研究发现，ALiBi的失效模式会显著损害令牌检索能力，但对标准解码器基准影响甚微。我们提出了四种训练期缓解策略，并分别及组合评估，发现对数尺度距离能带来最一致的passkey检索性能提升。尽管存在此问题，默认ALiBi斜率仍是出人意料的强大基线，尤其在needle-in-a-haystack检索任务中表现优异。基于这些发现，我们提供了使用ALiBi训练模型的具体建议。

summary: We present string2string Studio, an interactive in-browser platform for string-to-string analysis across natural language processing, computational biology, and the digital humanities. The system integrates six main modules (alignment, distance, similarity, search, generation metrics, and BLAST homology search), operating at character, word, token, line, and residue levels. Its C++-based algorithms compile to WebAssembly, so core operations run locally by default without any installation or data upload. The interface reports scores with their "evidence" (alignments, edit paths, metric matches, search hits, and homology traces), making methods inspectable, debuggable, and comparable on shared inputs. Internal benchmarks show speedups of up to 2,500x over the Python predecessor, faster global/local alignment than a general-purpose native C aligner, and exact agreement with independent references under declared settings. For homology search, the scoped client-side blastn path closely matches NCBI BLAST+ rankings and statistics under matched parameters. A curated showcase and Learn mode present canonical algorithms and metrics as reusable demonstrations. string2string Studio is open-source and freely available at string2string.org.
title: string2string Studio: An Interactive, In-Browser Platform for String-to-String Algorithms
title_translated: string2string Studio：一个用于字符串到字符串算法的交互式浏览器平台
summary_translated: 我们提出了 string2string Studio，这是一个跨自然语言处理、计算生物学和数字人文领域的交互式浏览器平台，用于字符串到字符串分析。该系统集成了六个主要模块（对齐、距离、相似性、搜索、生成度量和BLAST同源搜索），可在字符、单词、标记、行和残基等不同层级上运行。其基于C++的算法编译为WebAssembly，因此核心操作默认在本地运行，无需安装或上传数据。界面会报告得分及其“证据”（如对齐结果、编辑路径、度量匹配、搜索命中和同源追踪），使方法可检查、可调试且可在共享输入下进行比较。内部基准测试显示，与Python前身相比速度提升高达2,500倍，全局/局部对齐速度优于通用原生C对齐器，并在声明设置下与独立参考结果完全一致。对于同源搜索，客户端范围内的blastn路径在匹配参数下与NCBI BLAST+排名和统计结果高度一致。经过精心策划的展示和学习模式呈现了可复用的经典算法和度量。string2string Studio 是开源且免费的，可通过 string2string.org 获取。

summary: Large language models can generate fluent Arabic answers while introducing factual errors that are difficult to identify and verify. Existing Arabic hallucination resources often assign a binary label to an entire response, indicating whether it is hallucinated or non-hallucinated, but provide limited information about the exact erroneous content, the reason for the error, or the correct factual answer. We present HalluTruthQA-4K, an expanded version of the HalluTruthQA resource containing 4,000 expert-curated Arabic question-answering instances across four knowledge-intensive domains: Islamic knowledge, history, science, and geography. Serving as the official dataset for Track 2 of the HalluScoring 2026 shared task, HalluTruthQA-4K extends our original corpus to 4,000 instances. Each instance pairs an Arabic question with a model-generated response, a verified reference answer, and five plausible distractors. Hallucinated responses are additionally annotated with character-level erroneous spans, human-written explanations, and hierarchical hallucination types. The corpus contains 1,643 hallucinated and 2,357 non-hallucinated responses, with 1,843 annotated erroneous spans. We describe the resource construction and annotation methodology, including question selection, controlled answer generation, candidate construction, expert annotation, independent verification, adjudication, and quality control. We also document the annotation guidelines, taxonomy, data format, inter-annotator agreement, and corpus statistics. HalluTruthQA-4K provides a reusable resource for hallucination detection, span-level error localization, explanation generation, factual verification, and the broader evaluation of factual reliability in Arabic language models.
title: HalluTruthQA-4K: A Fine-Grained Corpus and Annotation Process for Arabic Hallucination Detection and Truth Verification
title_translated: HalluTruthQA-4K：面向阿拉伯语幻觉检测与事实验证的细粒度语料库与标注流程
summary_translated: 大型语言模型能够生成流畅的阿拉伯语回答，但常引入难以识别和验证的事实错误。现有的阿拉伯语幻觉资源通常仅对整个回答赋予二元标签（是否幻觉），却缺乏关于错误内容、错误原因或正确事实答案的详细信息。我们提出 HalluTruthQA-4K，这是 HalluTruthQA 资源的扩展版本，包含4,000个专家标注的阿拉伯语问答实例，覆盖伊斯兰知识、历史、科学和地理四个知识密集型领域。该语料库作为 HalluScoring 2026 共享任务 Track 2 的官方数据集，将原始语料库扩展至4,000个实例。每个实例包含一个阿拉伯语问题、一个模型生成的回答、一个经验证的参考答案以及五个合理的干扰项。幻觉回答还额外标注了字符级错误片段、人工撰写的解释和分层的幻觉类型。语料库包含1,643个幻觉回答和2,357个非幻觉回答，共标注1,843个错误片段。我们描述了资源构建与标注方法，包括问题选择、受控回答生成、候选构造、专家标注、独立验证、裁决和质量控制。同时记录了标注指南、分类体系、数据格式、标注者间一致性及语料库统计数据。HalluTruthQA-4K 提供了一个可重复使用的资源，可用于幻觉检测、错误片段定位、解释生成、事实验证以及阿拉伯语语言模型事实可靠性的广泛评估。

summary: Pre-pretraining language models (LMs) on symbolic data can accelerate and improve natural language acquisition. However, existing pre-pretraining tasks, such as Dyck and procedural algorithms, rely on narrow primitives that fail to capture the expressive capacity of natural language. Moreover, prior studies remain restricted to relatively small token budgets, offering limited insight into skill emergence and representational dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose logic pre-pretraining (Logic-PPT) as a principled initialization strategy, leveraging formal derivations to impart richer structural and linguistic biases. Formal derivations require abstract mechanisms that are central to natural language, simultaneously binding variables, connecting quantifiers and relational dependencies, and composing predicate-argument structures over long contexts. Scaling our evaluation to a 100B-token regime, logic pre-pretraining substantially accelerates skill acquisition in LMs, achieving 80\% accuracy on linguistic tasks with 36B fewer tokens than standard initialization, and outperforming alternative pre-pretraining baselines. Mechanistically, formal derivations induce persistent structural reorganization, distinctively characterized by a lower-rank, spectrally concentrated representation space. Crucially, we show that this internal geometry enables improved model compressibility via pruning, matching the dense baseline performance even at $\approx$33\% sparsity.
title: Logic Before Language: Pre-pretraining on Formal Derivations Fosters Skill Acquisition and Compressibility
title_translated: 逻辑先于语言：在形式推导上进行预预训练促进技能获取与模型压缩性
summary_translated: 在符号数据上对语言模型（LMs）进行预预训练可以加速并提升自然语言习得能力。然而，现有预预训练任务（如 Dyck 语言和过程算法）依赖于狭窄的原始操作，无法充分捕捉自然语言的表达能力。此外，先前研究受限于较小的词元预算，难以深入理解技能涌现与表征动态。为解决这些局限，我们提出逻辑预预训练（Logic-PPT）作为一种原则性初始化策略，利用形式推导赋予更丰富的结构与语言偏置。形式推导要求抽象机制，这些机制是自然语言的核心，能同时绑定变量、连接量词与关系依赖，并在长上下文中组合谓词-论元结构。我们将评估规模扩展至1000亿词元级别，结果显示逻辑预预训练显著加速了语言模型的技能获取，在比标准初始化少使用360亿词元的情况下达到80%的语言任务准确率，并优于其他预预训练基线。从机制上看，形式推导引发持久的结构重组，表现为低秩且谱集中表示空间。关键的是，我们证明这种内部几何结构可通过剪枝实现更好的模型压缩性，在约33%稀疏度下仍能匹配密集基线性能。

summary: The automatic structural analysis of legal texts is a cornerstone of legal technology, yet the extraction of their logical components remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we introduce the task of identifying and segmenting legal conditions (Tatbestand) and legal consequences (Rechtsfolge) within German statutory texts. To support this task, we present ANNOTARES (Annotations of Tatbestand-Rechtsfolge Sequences), a novel dataset comprising German law texts with span-level annotations. Spanning three distinct legal codes, the dataset is designed to evaluate both domain-specific performance and cross-statute generalizability. We benchmark diverse architectural approaches: a rule-based baseline, CRFs, BiLSTMs, BiLSTM-CRF, and modern Transformer-based models, including BERT variants and LLM-based methods. Our results demonstrate that BERT and LLM-based models achieve superior performance in capturing the complex syntactic structures of legal language. We release our dataset to facilitate further research in automated legal reasoning.
title: ANNOTARES: A Dataset for Extracting Logical Structures from German Statutory Texts
title_translated: ANNOTARES：从德语法规文本中提取逻辑结构的数据集
summary_translated: 法律文本的自动结构分析是法律科技的核心，但其逻辑组件的提取仍是重大挑战。本文提出识别和分割德语法规文本中的法律要件（Tatbestand）与法律后果（Rechtsfolge）的任务。为此，我们介绍了 ANNOTARES（Tatbestand-Rechtsfolge 序列标注），一个包含德语法律文本的新型数据集，具有跨度级标注。该数据集涵盖三个不同的法律法典，旨在评估特定领域表现及跨法典泛化能力。我们对多种架构进行了基准测试：基于规则的基线、CRF、BiLSTM、BiLSTM-CRF，以及现代Transformer模型（包括BERT变体和大模型方法）。结果表明，BERT和基于大模型的方法在捕捉法律语言复杂句法结构方面表现更优。我们已发布该数据集，以推动自动化法律推理的进一步研究。

summary: This paper describes our submissions to eRisk 2026 Task 3, ADHD Symptom Sentence Ranking. The task requires systems to rank candidate Reddit sentences according to their relevance to each of the 18 symptoms in the Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale (ASRS-v1.1). Because no annotated training data were released for this first edition of the task, we relied on zero-shot experimentation, manual validation, and unsupervised or weakly guided retrieval pipelines. Our systems combine sparse BM25 retrieval, evidence-aware rescoring for self-referential symptom reports, embedding-based reranking, query-prototype expansion, and LLM-based reranking. All submitted systems follow a staged retrieval design in which BM25 retrieves candidates at scale and semantic or LLM rerankers refine the final rankings. Among our submissions, the LLM reranker achieved the strongest official scores, followed by the prototype query-expansion run. Our manual top-10 analysis aligned with the official expert scoring trend, suggesting that staged reranking is a promising direction for further development.
title: DS@GT-ARC at eRisk 2026 Task 3: Sparse, Semantic, and LLM Reranking for ADHD Symptom Sentences
title_translated: DS@GT-ARC 在 eRisk 2026 任务3中的工作：针对ADHD症状句子的稀疏、语义与大模型重排序
summary_translated: 本文描述了我们在 eRisk 2026 任务3（ADHD症状句子排序）中的提交方案。该任务要求系统根据成人ADHD自评量表（ASRS-v1.1）中的18种症状，对候选Reddit句子进行相关性排序。由于本年度首次发布任务未提供标注训练数据，我们依赖零样本实验、手动验证以及无监督或弱指导的检索管道。我们的系统结合了稀疏BM25检索、针对自我报告症状的证据感知重评分、基于嵌入的重排序、查询原型扩展以及大模型驱动的重排序。所有提交系统均采用分阶段检索设计：BM25在大规模范围内召回候选句，随后由语义或大模型重排序器优化最终排名。在各项提交中，大模型重排序器取得了最强的官方得分，其次为原型查询扩展方案。我们的手动前10名分析与官方专家评分趋势一致，表明分阶段重排序是未来发展的有前景方向。

summary: Geospatial reasoning, i.e., computing distances, containment, and other spatial relations over real-world entities, is central to navigation and logistics, yet large language models (LLMs) struggle with the required geometric and topological computation despite storing considerable geographic knowledge. Existing benchmarks localize these failures only partially: they are synthetic or smallscale, largely monolingual, and offer limited control over geographic coverage. We introduce MultiGlobeQA, a multilingual benchmark of 46,060 question-answer pairs spanning 14 spatial-function families and 15 answer formats, with execution-based ground truth over three knowledge graphs. It covers 201 countries and territories via income- and density-stratified sampling, with parallel questions in English and 16 additional high- and low-resource languages. Across parametric, reasoning, and agentic settings, LLMs collapse on tasks requiring grid indexing and shape computation, while topological relations and directions fare best. Retrieval and tool use yield considerable gains, yet performance plateaus below two thirds even when gold facts are supplied, indicating that computation, not access to knowledge, is the bottleneck. Models also underperform on low-income regions, a gap that gold facts widen rather than close.
title: MultiGlobeQA: A Multilingual and Globally Diverse Benchmark for Geospatial Reasoning
title_translated: MultiGlobeQA：面向地理空间推理的多语言与全球多样性基准测试
summary_translated: 地理空间推理，即对现实世界实体之间的距离、包含关系及其他空间关系进行计算，是导航和物流的核心，但大型语言模型（LLMs）尽管存储了大量地理知识，仍难以完成所需的几何与拓扑计算。现有基准在定位这些失败方面存在局限：它们多为合成数据或小规模数据集，主要为单语种，且对地理覆盖范围的控制有限。我们提出了MultiGlobeQA，一个包含46,060个问答对的多语言基准，涵盖14种空间函数类别和15种答案格式，并基于三个知识图谱采用执行式真值验证。该基准通过收入与密度分层采样覆盖201个国家和地区，提供英语及16种高资源和低资源语言的平行问题。在参数化、推理和代理设置下，LLMs在需要网格索引和形状计算的任务上表现严重下降，而拓扑关系和方向判断表现最佳。检索与工具使用带来显著提升，但即使提供真实事实，性能仍低于三分之二，表明瓶颈在于计算能力而非知识获取。模型在低收入地区的表现也较差，而真实事实反而扩大了这一差距。

summary: We introduce SciRet, a compute-aware empirical study of retrieval-augmented generation for scientific question answering over CORD-19. Rather than proposing a new model, we evaluate a fixed scientific RAG pipeline across three corpus scales: 1,034 chunks (1K papers), 5,160 chunks (5K papers), and 15,480 chunks (15K papers). The pipeline combines sentence-window chunking, BM25, BGE-M3 dense retrieval, reciprocal rank fusion, optional cross-encoder reranking, and grounded answer generation. Across these settings, hybrid retrieval is more robust than either sparse-only or dense-only retrieval in our setting, reaching Recall@10 of 1.000 at 1K and 15K. In contrast, an MS MARCO-trained cross-encoder reranker reduces precision on the scientific corpus, suggesting that domain mismatch can outweigh the benefits of stronger query-passage interaction. Generation faithfulness measured with RAGAS increases with corpus scale in our setup. Retrieval evaluation uses pseudo-relevance labels derived from the hybrid system, so we treat the results as controlled comparative evidence rather than a benchmark claim. We release code, indexes, and evaluation outputs to support replication and follow-up studies.
title: SciRet: A Compute-Aware Empirical Study of Retrieval and Reranking for Scientific RAG
title_translated: SciRet：面向科学RAG的检索与重排序的计算感知实证研究
summary_translated: 我们介绍了SciRet，一项针对CORD-19科学问答任务中检索增强生成（RAG）的计算感知实证研究。不同于提出新模型，我们评估了一个固定科学RAG流水线在三种语料库规模下的表现：1,034个片段（1K篇论文）、5,160个片段（5K篇论文）和15,480个片段（15K篇论文）。该流水线结合句子窗口切块、BM25、BGE-M3密集检索、倒数排名融合、可选交叉编码器重排序以及基于事实的答案生成。在所有设置中，混合检索比仅稀疏或仅密集检索更稳健，在1K和15K规模下达到Recall@10为1.000。相比之下，基于MS MARCO训练的交叉编码器重排序在科学语料库上降低了精度，表明领域不匹配可能超过更强查询-段落交互带来的优势。在我们的设置中，使用RAGAS衡量的生成忠实度随语料库规模增加而提高。检索评估使用从混合系统推导出的伪相关标签，因此我们将结果视为受控对比证据而非基准声明。我们公开代码、索引和评估输出，以支持复现与后续研究。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) pose challenges to academic integrity and peer review. Yet generative plagiarism detection remains an underexplored and largely unresolved challenge. Prior work on LLM-generated-text detection targets AI involvement, which may be permissible, rather than source reuse, while similarity-based methods struggle after extensive rewriting and multi-source synthesis. Motivated by the description-length view of probabilistic prediction, in which relevant side information can reduce a target sequence's code length, we introduce Source-Conditioned Description-Length Gain (SCDG), a directional, training-free framework that contrasts a frozen language model's description length of a suspicious document $P$ with and without a candidate source $S$. This contrast yields token-level log-likelihood gains that measure the incremental predictive evidence supplied by $S$. We evaluate SCDG on the PAN at CLEF benchmarks for generative plagiarism. On a PAN 2025-derived pairwise benchmark, SCDG achieves 0.92 Precision, 0.97 Recall, and 0.94 F1, outperforming all baselines; on PAN 2026's multi-source retrieval task, it reaches 0.83 nDCG@10 and 0.96 Recall@100, surpassing all baselines. On a same-topic, same-event Multi-News test, the calibrated gain-distribution SCDG classifier predicts source reuse for only $0.125\%$ of pairs, supporting robustness to topical overlap under this evaluation protocol. These results establish SCDG as a unified and token-decomposable signal for source-specific content reuse under extensive transformation.
title: Beyond Representational Similarity: Source-Conditioned Description-Length Gain for Generative Plagiarism Detection and Candidate Source Reranking
title_translated: 超越表征相似性：用于生成型抄袭检测与候选源重排序的源条件描述长度增益
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）对学术诚信和同行评审构成挑战。然而，生成型抄袭检测仍是未充分探索且基本未解决的难题。先前关于LLM生成文本检测的工作聚焦于AI参与，这可能是允许的，而非源内容重用；而基于相似性的方法在经过广泛改写和多源合成后表现不佳。受概率预测中描述长度观点的启发——相关附加信息可减少目标序列的编码长度——我们提出了源条件描述长度增益（SCDG），一种方向性、无需训练的框架，通过对比冻结语言模型在有无候选源S的情况下对可疑文档P的描述长度，获得衡量S提供的增量预测证据的词元级对数似然增益。我们在CLEF的PAN基准上评估SCDG在生成型抄袭检测中的表现。在基于PAN 2025的成对基准上，SCDG取得0.92精确率、0.97召回率和0.94 F1，优于所有基线；在PAN 2026的多源检索任务中，达到0.83 nDCG@10和0.96 Recall@100，同样超越所有基线。在同主题、同事件的Multi-News测试中，校准后的增益分布SCDG分类器仅对0.125%的文本对预测为源重用，支持其在该评估协议下对主题重叠的鲁棒性。这些结果确立了SCDG作为在广泛变换下源特定内容重用的统一且可分解至词元级别的信号。

summary: When a language model fails on surface-perturbed input (typos, OCR noise, homophones), "which layer is responsible" has three natural operationalizations: where representations diverge most (sensitivity), where restoring clean activations recovers the prediction (causality), and where a small adapter can repair the damage (compensatory capacity) - and we show these three layer maps dissociate. Across a five-model panel we identify two propagation regimes - spike-and-suppress (Phi-3.5, Gemma-2-9B) and late-accumulation (Llama-3, Mistral, Qwen2.5-7B) - and on the two models meeting an 80% identity-patch gate, sensitivity and causality are anti-correlated (rho = -0.72 to -0.88). Within-family scaling on Qwen2.5 (1.5B to 14B) shows the late-accumulation signature strengthening monotonically with scale, corroborated on a second family. We propose cascade disruption as the mechanism behind the dissociation: adapters placed at causally implicated early layers break intact downstream computation, making diagnostic-flagged sites the worst adapter placements. A fixed-harness layer sweep across four models (3.8-8B) confirms the core prediction on chain-of-thought GSM8K - the flagged sites are the most damaging adapter windows on every adjudicable model - and is sign-consistent but strongly attenuated on a multiple-choice control, consistent with damage that compounds with generation length. The sweep yields practical guidance: a training-free LRD pre-screen and a default-deepest placement rule, though absolute gains over no-adapter baselines remain small. Finally, apparent gains from a representation-stability loss reverse under an adequate generation budget - truncated chain-of-thought had been scored as empty - a methodological warning for any intervention evaluated on chain-of-thought tasks.
title: Sensitivity, Causality, and Repair Dissociate: A Layer-Wise Analysis of Perturbation Robustness and Its Scaling
title_translated: 敏感性、因果性与修复分离：扰动鲁棒性及其缩放的逐层分析
summary_translated: 当语言模型在表面扰动输入（如拼写错误、OCR噪声、同音词）上失败时，“哪一层负责”有三种自然的操作化定义：表示差异最大的层（敏感性）、恢复干净激活后能恢复预测的层（因果性），以及可通过小型适配器修复损伤的层（补偿能力）——我们证明这三个层图是分离的。在五个模型的面板中，我们识别出两种传播模式：尖峰抑制型（Phi-3.5、Gemma-2-9B）和后期累积型（Llama-3、Mistral、Qwen2.5-7B）。在满足80%身份补丁门限的两个模型上，敏感性与因果性呈负相关（rho = -0.72 至 -0.88）。在Qwen2.5家族（1.5B到14B）的缩放研究中，后期累积特征随规模单调增强，第二组家族也得到验证。我们提出级联破坏是导致分离的原因：放置在因果相关早期层的适配器会破坏下游完整计算，使诊断标记的区域成为最差的适配器放置位置。在四个模型（3.8-8B）上的固定支架层扫描确认了核心预测：在链式思维GSM8K任务中，标记区域是每个可判定模型中最具破坏性的适配器窗口；在多项选择控制任务中，结果符号一致但强度显著减弱，与生成长度相关的损害累积一致。该扫描提供了实用指导：无需训练的LRD预筛选和默认最深层放置规则，尽管相对于无适配器基线的绝对增益仍然较小。最后，看似来自表示稳定性损失的增益在充足生成预算下逆转——截断的链式思维被误判为空——这是对任何在链式思维任务上评估干预措施的方法论警告。

summary: Large language models routinely describe socially salient targets, including political figures, countries, religions, organizations, historical events, and social groups, encoding affective framing alongside factual content: a target may appear favorable or threatening, calm or conflictual, powerful or vulnerable. Existing work captures parts of this space through sentiment, favorability, and emotion benchmarks, but none combines target-directed VAD attribution, an explicit scorer contract, and a passport reporting format. We introduce VIBE, a benchmark for entity-centered affective profiling of LLM outputs in Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) space. Its core contribution is a measurement contract: VIBE separates generation from external scoring, distinguishes scalar favorability, response-level VAD, and target-directed VAD, and reports profiles through an Affective Passport. Three empirical layers support the contract. H1 shows scalar favorability does not subsume arousal and dominance: valence findings are cross-validated (rV = 0.944 judge-human, rV = 0.954 inter-scorer); arousal and dominance are single-scorer directional estimates, not point-precise, consistent with known inter-annotator difficulty on these axes (rA = 0.495, rD = 0.702 among human annotators). H2 shows whole-response and target-directed VAD are different contracts: the same text can carry one affective tone overall while representing the named target differently. H3 is a protocol-drift diagnostic: elicitation conditions shift profiles, motivating context metadata in every affective report. These results motivate entity-centered affective profiling as a documented practice: profiles should be released with scorer identity, coverage, protocol, and interpretation limits.
title: VIBE: A VAD-Informed Benchmark for Entity-Centered Affective Profiling of Large Language Model Outputs
comment: 25 pages, 13 figures, 22 tables. Submitted to ACL Rolling Review, August 2026
title_translated: VIBE：面向大语言模型输出的以情感为中心的实体剖析的VAD感知基准
summary_translated: 大型语言模型经常描述具有社会重要性的目标，包括政治人物、国家、宗教、组织、历史事件和社会群体，同时在事实内容之外编码情感框架：一个目标可能呈现为有利或威胁性、平静或冲突性、强大或脆弱。现有工作通过情感、倾向性和情绪基准捕捉该空间的部分内容，但没有一个同时结合目标导向的VAD归因、明确的评分合同和护照报告格式。我们引入VIBE，一个面向大语言模型输出在效价-唤醒-主导力（VAD）空间中以实体为中心的情感剖析基准。其核心贡献是测量合同：VIBE将生成与外部评分分离，区分标量倾向性、响应级VAD和目标导向VAD，并通过情感护照报告剖面。三个实证层面支持该合同。H1表明标量倾向性并不涵盖唤醒和主导力：效价发现得到交叉验证（rV = 0.944 人类-评委，rV = 0.954 评分者间）；唤醒和主导力是单评分者的方向性估计，非点精确值，与这些维度上已知的人类标注者难度一致（rA = 0.495，rD = 0.702）。H2表明整体响应与目标导向VAD是不同的合同：同一文本可能整体呈现一种情感基调，但对命名目标的表达却不同。H3是协议漂移诊断：诱发条件会改变剖面，促使每个情感报告中加入上下文元数据。这些结果推动以实体为中心的情感剖析作为一种可记录实践：剖面应附带评分者身份、覆盖范围、协议和解释限制。

summary: Multilingual language models are deployed across a hundred or more languages, yet most benchmarks test whether a model can perform a task _in_ a language rather than whether it commands the language itself, conflating fluency with proficiency. We introduce M-GATE (Multilingual Grammar, Accuracy in Translation, and Efficiency), a benchmark of linguistic proficiency spanning 30 typologically diverse languages from high- to low-resource. M-GATE comprises three tasks: grammatical error detection on linguist-crafted, adversarially selected sentences that turn on hard, language-specific phenomena; round-trip translation of shared English sources across 29 target languages, scored by a three-provider LLM judge panel validated against professional annotators; and a supplementary tokenizer-efficiency measure. We evaluate over 50 models in more than 80 configurations. Fluency and proficiency come apart sharply: models that translate competently sit near chance on the adversarial grammar items, the best reaching a Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) of only 0.36, and their errors lean systematically toward under-flagging, accepting ungrammatical text rather than raising false alarms. Translation quality closely tracks a language's share of pretraining data (r = 0.86 against log Common Crawl share), producing a steep low-resource penalty that is nonetheless narrowing with successive model releases. Enabling reasoning reliably improves translation, while its effect on error detection is smaller and for some models negative, so the best configuration is task-dependent. To resist contamination, test items are kept private behind a continuously updated public leaderboard, with illustrative examples released (https://m-gate.ai).
title: M-GATE: Multilingual Grammar, Accuracy in Translation, and Efficiency Benchmark for Large Language Models
title_translated: M-GATE：多语言语法、翻译准确率与效率基准测试
summary_translated: 多语言语言模型已部署于一百多种语言，但大多数基准测试仅检验模型在某种语言中完成任务的能力，而非其对语言本身的掌握程度，混淆了流利度与熟练度。我们提出了M-GATE（多语言语法、翻译准确率与效率），一个涵盖30种类型多样、从高资源到低资源语言的语言熟练度基准。M-GATE包含三项任务：针对语言学家精心设计、对抗性选取的句子进行语法错误检测；对29种目标语言共享英文源文本进行往返翻译，由三名LLM评委小组评分，并经专业标注者验证；以及补充的分词器效率测量。我们在超过50个模型的80多种配置下进行了评估。流利度与熟练度明显分离：能够胜任翻译的模型在对抗性语法项目上表现接近随机水平，最佳模型的马修斯相关系数（MCC）仅为0.36，且错误系统性地倾向于低估标记，接受不合法语句而非发出误报。翻译质量与语言在预训练数据中的占比高度相关（r = 0.86，以Common Crawl日志份额为基准），导致显著的低资源惩罚，但随着模型版本迭代，这一差距正在缩小。启用推理能可靠提升翻译性能，但对错误检测的影响较小，甚至对某些模型产生负面影响，因此最优配置依赖于具体任务。为防止数据污染，测试项保持私密，仅通过持续更新的公开排行榜发布示例（https://m-gate.ai）。

summary: Small language models are often the only option for deployment under tight latency, cost, and on-premises constraints, but they are rarely trained from scratch: a compressed model is usually recovered through knowledge distillation (KD). This recovery step largely decides the final quality, yet it is expensive. We present a practitioner's study of how to make distillation training efficient, organised around two systems contributions. First, we show that offline KD (caching the teacher's top-$K$ logits once and training the student against the cache) matches online distillation at near-identical training loss while removing the teacher from memory, running about 29\% faster per iteration, and reaching up to 41\% higher throughput on a single H200 GPU. Second, we introduce a \emph{fused, chunked KL loss} that never materialises the full vocabulary-sized logit tensor, making peak memory linear in the sequence length. This removes the memory spike that otherwise caps context length and lets us train at four times the context (32{,}768 tokens) on a single GPU. A separate output-head-only toy benchmark isolates the loss kernel and confirms its memory and iteration-rate scaling from 4K to 256K tokens. Together these make large-scale healing and hundreds of ablations affordable. We also report supporting ablations on loss design and sequence packing. We release our chunked-loss implementation: https://github.com/CompactifAI/Full-Chunked-KL-Loss.
title: Efficient Knowledge Distillation for LLMs: Offline Top-K Logits and a Fused Chunked KL Loss
title_translated: 高效知识蒸馏用于大语言模型：离线Top-K logits与融合分块KL损失
summary_translated: 在严格延迟、成本和本地部署约束下，小型语言模型通常是唯一可行的选择，但它们很少从头训练：通常通过知识蒸馏（KD）恢复压缩模型。这一恢复步骤很大程度上决定了最终质量，但代价高昂。我们开展了一项面向实践者的高效蒸馏训练研究，围绕两项系统性贡献展开。首先，我们证明离线KD（一次性缓存教师模型的Top-K logits，学生模型基于缓存训练）可在几乎相同的训练损失下实现与在线蒸馏相当的效果，同时将教师模型移出内存，每轮训练速度提升约29%，单张H200 GPU上的吞吐量最高提升41%。其次，我们提出一种“融合分块KL损失”，避免生成完整词汇表大小的logit张量，使峰值内存仅随序列长度线性增长。这消除了原本限制上下文长度的内存峰值，使我们能在单张GPU上将上下文长度提升至四倍（32,768 tokens）。一个独立的仅输出头的简化基准测试隔离了损失核函数，确认其在4K至256K tokens范围内的内存与迭代速率缩放特性。这两项改进共同使大规模修复和数百次消融实验变得可行。我们还报告了关于损失设计和序列打包的辅助消融实验。我们已开源分块损失实现：https://github.com/CompactifAI/Full-Chunked-KL-Loss。

summary: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) enable parallel generation and bidirectional context modeling, but their positional context differs fundamentally from that of autoregressive (AR) models. Whereas AR decoding exposes a contiguous prefix, MDLM denoising produces dynamic, non-contiguous configurations of revealed and masked tokens. Conventional positional encodings such as RoPE capture sequence order and pairwise displacement but remain insensitive to this evolving token-availability structure. To address this limitation, we propose MDLMPE, a positional encoding designed specifically for masked diffusion. To the best of our knowledge, MDLMPE is the first method to make positional representations explicitly aware of the changing revealed/masked configuration. It represents token availability as a binary sequence, applies distance-aware Gaussian weighting, and projects the resulting pattern through a cosine basis to obtain distribution-aware positional features. These features are added to token embeddings and mapped by a lightweight MLP to angular offsets that modulate the standard RoPE phases. Extensive experiments on LLaDA and DREAM demonstrate that MDLMPE generally outperforms conventional positional encoding methods across supervised fine-tuning, pretraining, zero-shot evaluation, and block-diffusion settings. Further ablations show that the complete combination of availability state, Gaussian locality, spectral basis, and embedding injection yields the strongest result. These results establish the evolving token-availability distribution as a useful positional signal for masked diffusion language models.
title: MDLMPE: Distribution Aware Positional Encoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models
title_translated: MDLMPE：面向掩码扩散语言模型的分布感知位置编码
summary_translated: 掩码扩散语言模型（MDLMs）支持并行生成和双向上下文建模，但其位置上下文与自回归（AR）模型存在根本差异。AR解码暴露的是连续前缀，而MDLM去噪会产生动态、非连续的已揭示与被遮蔽标记配置。传统的如RoPE的位置编码虽能捕捉序列顺序和成对位移，却对这种不断变化的标记可用性结构不敏感。为解决此问题，我们提出MDLMPE，一种专为掩码扩散设计的位置编码。据我们所知，MDLMPE是首个使位置表示显式感知动态揭示/遮蔽配置的方法。它将标记可用性表示为二进制序列，应用距离感知的高斯加权，并通过余弦基投影得到分布感知的位置特征。这些特征被添加到标记嵌入中，并由轻量级MLP映射为角度偏移，调节标准RoPE相位。在LLaDA和DREAM上的大量实验表明，MDLMPE在监督微调、预训练、零样本评估和块扩散设置中普遍优于传统位置编码方法。进一步的消融实验显示，可用状态、高斯局部性、谱基和嵌入注入的完整组合带来最佳效果。这些结果确立了动态标记可用性分布作为掩码扩散语言模型的有效位置信号。

summary: Automated Knowledge Base Construction (AKBC) is a core NLP task, and recent work proposes generating knowledge bases directly from large language models (LLMs), treating the model itself as the knowledge source. However, LLMs natively possess no representation of entities, leading to duplicate entries as well as conflations. We propose GPTKB 2.0, a methodology for constructing disambiguated KBs directly from LLMs. GPTKB 2.0 incorporates on-the-fly disambiguation of entities, relations and classes, and is meticulously designed to satisfy both scalability and disambiguation accuracy. We analyze the central design decisions and characterize the trade-offs between accuracy, scale, and cost. We execute GPTKB 2.0 at scale, obtaining a materialized KB containing over 1M disambiguated entities and 38.4M triples. This represents the first million-scale LLM-native KB with explicit internal canonicalization of entities, relations, and classes, a significant departure from prior Wikimedia-centric works. GPTKB 2.0 is available at https://gptkb.org/.
title: GPTKB 2.0: Direct Construction of Disambiguated Knowledge Bases from Large Language Models
title_translated: GPTKB 2.0：从大语言模型直接构建消歧知识库
summary_translated: 自动化知识库构建（AKBC）是核心自然语言处理任务，近期工作提出直接从大语言模型（LLMs）生成知识库，将模型本身视为知识来源。然而，LLMs天然缺乏实体表示，导致重复条目和概念混淆。我们提出GPTKB 2.0，一种直接从LLMs构建消歧知识库的方法论。GPTKB 2.0结合实时实体、关系和类别的消歧机制，精心设计以兼顾可扩展性与消歧准确性。我们分析了核心设计决策，并刻画了准确性、规模与成本之间的权衡。我们在大规模上执行GPTKB 2.0，获得一个包含超过100万消歧实体和3840万三元组的实体化知识库。这是首个百万级的LLM原生知识库，具有显式的内部规范化机制，明确区分实体、关系和类别，与以往以维基媒体为中心的工作有显著区别。GPTKB 2.0现已开放：https://gptkb.org/

summary: Large language models can generate fluent responses to Islamic questions while introducing factual errors that are difficult to identify. This paper presents our system for \textsc{HalluScoring 2026} Task 2.1, \textit{Islamic Hallucination Detection and Find the Truth}. The task requires a unified two-step prediction: determining whether an Arabic answer generated by an LLM is hallucinated and selecting the verified answer from six closely related candidate options. We use the Islamic knowledge dataset provided by the shared task, which contains 600 question--answer instances, including 341 hallucinated and 259 non-hallucinated answers. Our system is based on the fine-tuned \texttt{google/gemma-4-12B-it} model and uses deterministic decoding during inference. The generated outputs are normalized to extract the hallucination label and the selected option. The system achieves a Macro-F1 score of 0.928 and a label accuracy of 0.935 for hallucination detection, together with an option accuracy of 0.895 for answer selection. These results yield a combined score of 0.912, demonstrating strong performance across both stages of the task. The lower option-selection accuracy indicates that distinguishing the verified answer from plausible alternatives remains more challenging than detecting hallucinated responses.
title: Detecting Hallucinations and Recovering Verified Answers in Arabic Islamic Question Answering
title_translated: 阿拉伯语伊斯兰问答中的幻觉检测与真实答案恢复
summary_translated: 大语言模型能流畅回答伊斯兰相关问题，但常引入难以识别的事实性错误。本文介绍了我们为	extsc{HalluScoring 2026}任务2.1（伊斯兰幻觉检测与寻找真相）开发的系统。该任务要求统一的两步预测：判断LLM生成的阿拉伯语答案是否为幻觉，并从六个密切相关候选选项中选出经验证的真实答案。我们使用共享任务提供的伊斯兰知识数据集，包含600个问答实例，其中341个为幻觉答案，259个为非幻觉答案。我们的系统基于微调后的	exttt{google/gemma-4-12B-it}模型，推理时采用确定性解码。生成输出经过归一化以提取幻觉标签和选定选项。系统在幻觉检测上取得0.928的宏F1分数和0.935的标签准确率，在答案选择上达到0.895的准确率。综合得分0.912，表明在任务两个阶段均表现优异。较低的答案选择准确率表明，从看似合理的替代答案中区分真实答案仍比检测幻觉更具挑战性。

summary: Large hyperparameter sweeps for deep neural networks spend substantial compute on configurations that are effectively doomed from the first few epochs. We study whether a single training run's own early telemetry - per-epoch loss, training accuracy, gradient signal-to-noise ratio, weight-norm growth, and an activation-saturation snapshot - together with its sampled hyperparameters, can predict that run's eventual outcome without reference to other runs. We evaluate three prediction tasks: final test accuracy, relative performance within a domain, and training-dynamics failure, including numerical divergence. Across 23,788 training runs spanning six architecture/dataset combinations, gradient-boosted trees using only the first five epochs of telemetry achieve R^2 = 0.92-0.99 for final-accuracy regression and ROC-AUC = 0.983-0.998 for relative classification on a permanently held-out set of hyperparameter configurations. Useful prediction is already available after a single epoch. A paired ablation shows that gradient- and weight-level telemetry provides a statistically consistent improvement over loss and accuracy curves alone, although the practical gain varies by domain. Transfer is strong between similar architectures, while cross-dataset transfer is limited mainly by differences in accuracy scale rather than loss of the underlying relationship. These results suggest that early-training telemetry can provide a practical decision-support signal for compute allocation while motivating human oversight for any automated intervention.
title: Predicting Deep Neural Network Training Outcomes from Early Training Telemetry
title_translated: 从早期训练遥测数据预测深度神经网络训练结果
summary_translated: 针对深度神经网络的大规模超参数搜索在大量计算资源上投入了本应失败的配置。我们研究单个训练运行的早期遥测数据——每轮损失、训练准确率、梯度信噪比、权重范数增长以及激活饱和快照——结合其采样的超参数，是否能在不参考其他运行的情况下预测该运行的最终结果。我们评估了三项预测任务：最终测试准确率、领域内相对表现以及训练动态失败（包括数值发散）。在涵盖六种架构/数据集组合的23,788次训练运行中，仅使用前五个epoch的遥测数据，基于梯度提升树的方法在最终准确率回归任务上达到R² = 0.92–0.99，在永久保留的超参数配置集上进行相对分类时ROC-AUC达到0.983–0.998。仅一个epoch后即可获得有效预测。成对消融实验表明，梯度和权重级别的遥测数据相比仅使用损失和准确率曲线提供了统计上一致的改进，尽管实际收益因领域而异。相似架构间的迁移能力较强，而跨数据集迁移主要受限于准确率尺度差异而非底层关系的丧失。这些结果表明，早期训练遥测可为计算资源分配提供实用的决策支持信号，同时为任何自动化干预提供人类监督的动机。

summary: Citation excerpts can be used to increase the reliability of generated outputs and their faithfulness to cited sources, which is especially important in high-stakes domains such as human and veterinary medicine. However, this does not guarantee that generated claims are faithful to the provided excerpts. We present VetScore, a multi-step evaluation method for veterinary long-form question answering, designed to assess how well are generated claims supported by the provided excerpts, weighing this information by each claim's harm potential. VetScore first segments the output and decomposes it into individual claims, then scores each claim with respect to its harm potential and evaluates its faithfulness to source excerpts, and finally calculates the overall risk-adjusted score. We collect an expert-annotated meta-evaluation dataset, evaluate our approach with a range of judge models, and show that it achieves high correlations with veterinary experts even with small judge models, while offering explainability across multiple dimensions.
title: VetScore: Risk-Weighted Fact Verification for Veterinary Long-Form QA with Citations
title_translated: VetScore：基于引用的兽医长篇问答风险加权事实验证
summary_translated: 引用片段可用于提高生成输出的可靠性及其与引用来源的一致性，这在医疗等高风险领域尤为重要。然而，这并不能保证生成主张与所提供片段保持一致。我们提出VetScore，一种用于兽医长篇问答的多步骤评估方法，旨在评估生成主张在多大程度上得到所提供片段的支持，并根据每项主张的潜在危害进行加权。VetScore首先对输出进行分段并分解为独立主张，然后根据其危害潜力评分并评估其与源片段的一致性，最后计算整体风险调整后的得分。我们收集了一个由专家标注的元评估数据集，使用多种裁判模型评估该方法，结果显示即使使用小型裁判模型，其与兽医专家的相关性也很高，同时在多个维度上提供可解释性。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate scientific reviews, yet existing evaluations rarely examine whether different providers align with both conference decisions and human reviewing priorities within the same controlled setting. We compare reviews from OpenAI GPT-5.4, Google Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, and Anthropic Claude Opus 4.6 with human reviews and final decisions for 300 topic-matched ICLR 2026 submissions, equally divided among oral, poster, and rejected papers. Each model reviewed every paper using identical instructions and rating scales after decision information was removed. Our study contributes a cross-provider analysis of three complementary dimensions: alignment with broad and fine-grained decision categories, differences in recommendation-scale usage, and thematic agreement in identified weaknesses. All three LLMs distinguished accepted from rejected papers, but none reproduced the oral versus poster distinction present in human ratings. Scoring patterns were provider-specific: Gemini assigned systematically higher ratings, while OpenAI and Claude were closer to humans for rejected and poster papers but more critical of oral papers. Human and LLM reviews also differed in emphasis, with LLMs more frequently identifying missing baseline comparisons and humans more often raising computational-efficiency concerns. These results show that broad decision alignment does not imply agreement with finer human judgments or reviewing priorities.
title: How Closely Do LLM Reviews Align with Human Peer Review?
title_translated: 大型语言模型评审与人类同行评审的对齐程度如何？
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于生成科学评审意见，但现有评估很少在相同受控环境下检验不同提供商的评审是否与会议决策及人类评审优先事项保持一致。我们比较了OpenAI GPT-5.4、Google Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview和Anthropic Claude Opus 4.6三种模型的评审意见与人类评审意见以及ICLR 2026提交论文的最终决定，共300篇主题匹配的论文，平均分为口头报告、海报和拒稿三类。每种模型在移除决策信息后，使用相同的指令和评分标准对每篇论文进行评审。本研究贡献了三个互补维度的跨提供商分析：与广泛和细粒度决策类别的对齐程度、推荐评分尺度的差异，以及识别出弱点的主题一致性。所有三种LLM均能区分接受与拒绝的论文，但均未能再现人类评审中存在的口头报告与海报之间的区别。评分模式具有提供商特异性：Gemini系统性地给出更高评分，而OpenAI和Claude在拒稿和海报论文上更接近人类，但在口头报告论文上更为严格。人类与LLM评审在关注重点上也存在差异，LLM更常指出缺少基线对比，而人类更常提出计算效率问题。这些结果表明，广泛的决策对齐并不意味着与更精细的人类判断或评审优先事项一致。

summary: Abstractive summarization models remain vulnerable to factual inconsistency, redundancy, and weak length control. We propose a modular generation-and-selection framework for sentence-budget-constrained summarization. A pretrained generator produces multiple candidate summaries, which are decomposed into sentence-level candidates. A combinatorial selector then constructs the final summary by balancing relevance, factuality, and redundancy under an explicit budget. The framework supports MMR, ILP, and a DPP-inspired log-determinant objective without retraining the generator. Experiments on CNN/DailyMail, Multi-News, FaithBench, and TofuEval show consistent improvements in factuality and source-grounding metrics, especially for multi-document summarization, at the cost of lower reference-overlap scores. Human evaluation further indicates higher perceived consistency, relevance, clarity, and conciseness, with a small reduction in coherence. These results show that decoupling generation from selection provides a model-agnostic mechanism for improving factual grounding. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/bcfs-D05E/.
title: Decoupling Generation and Selection for Budget-Constrained Faithful Summarization
title_translated: 解耦生成与选择以实现预算约束下的忠实摘要
summary_translated: 抽象型摘要模型仍易出现事实不一致、冗余和长度控制薄弱等问题。我们提出一种模块化的生成与选择框架，用于句子预算约束下的摘要生成。预训练生成器产生多个候选摘要，这些摘要被分解为句子级候选项。随后，组合选择器在显式预算下平衡相关性、事实性和冗余性，构建最终摘要。该框架无需重新训练生成器即可支持MMR、ILP以及受DPP启发的对数行列式目标。在CNN/DailyMail、Multi-News、FaithBench和TofuEval上的实验表明，该方法在事实性和源基准确性指标上持续提升，尤其在多文档摘要中表现显著，代价是参考重叠分数降低。人工评估进一步显示，摘要在感知一致性、相关性、清晰度和简洁性方面更高，仅有小幅的连贯性下降。这些结果表明，将生成与选择解耦可提供一种无需依赖模型的改进事实基础机制。代码已公开于 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/bcfs-D05E/。

summary: Looped transformers have emerged as a parameter-efficient alternative to scaling depth for strong reasoning. By reusing one stack of layers across $T$ iterations, they attain the effective depth and reasoning capabilities of larger models at a fixed parameter count. Yet existing approaches suffer from latent overthinking and undifferentiated computation, largely because intermediate representations receive no guidance across loops. Multi-token prediction (MTP) supplies exactly the dense, forward-looking supervision the loop is missing. We propose \textsc{LoopMTP}, which links the two through a structural correspondence in latent space: a model that loops $T$ times can anticipate $T$ future tokens. \textsc{LoopMTP} realizes this by softly aligning the hidden state of loop $t$ with the embedding of the token $t$ steps ahead, while a lightweight gate preserves useful information across iterations. \textsc{LoopMTP} improves average accuracy by up to 8.1\% (relative) over the non-looped baseline, with training remaining stable for up to 15 loops.
title: LoopMTP: A looped transformer guided by latent multi-token prediction
title_translated: LoopMTP：由潜在多标记预测引导的循环Transformer
summary_translated: 循环Transformer作为一种参数高效的替代方案，可避免通过增加深度来提升强推理能力。通过在T次迭代中重复使用一层堆栈，它们在固定参数量下实现了更大模型的有效深度和推理能力。然而，现有方法存在潜在过度思考和计算无差别问题，主要是因为中间表示在循环间缺乏指导。多标记预测（MTP）恰好提供了循环所缺失的密集且前瞻性的监督。我们提出	extsc{LoopMTP}，通过潜在空间中的结构对应关系连接两者：一个循环T次的模型能够预测T个未来标记。	extsc{LoopMTP}通过软对齐第t次循环的隐藏状态与t步之后的标记嵌入实现这一目标，同时通过轻量级门控机制保留迭代间有用信息。	extsc{LoopMTP}相较于非循环基线，平均准确率最高提升8.1%（相对），且在最多15次循环下训练依然稳定。

summary: The personal archive of Konstantin Tsiolkovsky (1857-1935) is held as fond 555 of the Archive of the Russian Academy of Sciences. The archive scanned the fond and published the images, but with no queryable catalogue, no full-text search and no dataset: the holdings can only be browsed one page at a time. This paper describes a machine-readable catalogue of all 2,019 files and 51,008 scans, a dating for 1,969 files taken from the archive's own descriptions, a page-level classification of every scan into handwriting and typescript, and a growing corpus of machine transcriptions (currently 322 files, 5,454 scans).   It also reports a way to measure handwritten-text-recognition accuracy in an archive with no ground truth. Archives of the typewriter era often preserve one text twice, as manuscript and as a typed copy; transcribing both and comparing isolates the reading error, since source and pipeline are identical and only page difficulty differs. Across 294 such pairs from 27 files, two readings of a handwritten page agree on a median 37% of words. On two files that also have a published edition the estimate can be checked against ground truth: it is unbiased to within a percentage point and ranks pages as the truth does (rank correlation 0.92 where the edition is a faithful witness). This bounds use: two variants of one work here share 19% of words, below the rate at which two readings of a single page agree, so the redactions cannot be collated word by word at this quality. That negative result is reported as such, and the constraint is built into the tool.
title: A machine-readable catalogue of the Tsiolkovsky papers (fond 555, Archive of the Russian Academy of Sciences), and a way to measure how well its handwriting can be read

title_translated: 齐奥尔科夫斯基手稿档案的机器可读目录及其手写识别准确率的测量方法
summary_translated: 康斯坦丁·齐奥尔科夫斯基（1857-1935）的个人档案保存于俄罗斯科学院档案馆，编号为 fond 555。该档案已扫描并发布图像，但缺乏可查询的目录、全文搜索功能和数据集，只能逐页浏览。本文构建了包含全部2,019个文件和51,008张扫描件的机器可读目录，基于档案自身描述对其中1,969个文件进行了时间标注，对每张扫描件进行了手写体与打印体的页面级分类，并建立了一个不断增长的手写文本转录语料库（目前涵盖322个文件、5,454张扫描件）。此外，本文提出一种在无真实标签情况下评估档案手写识别准确率的方法：打字机时代常同时保存手稿与打印副本，通过分别转录两者并比较，可隔离出阅读错误（因源文本和处理流程相同，仅页面难度不同）。在27份文件中的294对样本中，两轮对手写页面的识别结果中位数仅一致37%的词汇。在两份同时存在已出版版本的文件上，该估计值与真实情况偏差小于百分点，且排序相关性达0.92（表明其能正确反映页面难度），验证了该方法的有效性。然而，该研究也发现同一作品的两个版本仅共享19%的词汇，低于单页双读一致性水平，因此无法以当前精度进行逐词校勘。这一负面结果被如实报告，并将此约束纳入工具设计中。

summary: Modern LLM-based ASR systems have established multilingual capability as a standard feature, leveraging large-scale multilingual corpora and LLMs' cross-lingual knowledge to achieve competitive performance across multilingual benchmarks. However, joint modeling of languages with heterogeneous acoustic, phonological, and lexical characteristics inevitably introduces optimization conflicts, undermining language-wise specialization. To address this challenge, we propose Language-Specialized Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (LS-MOPD), which decouples language-specific knowledge acquisition from multilingual capability integration: language-specialized teachers are independently optimized via reinforcement learning (RL), after which their expertise is integrated into a generalist multilingual student through language routing and token-level multi-teacher distillation, thereby reducing direct cross-lingual optimization conflicts. We further explore two acoustic-prefix configurations, static and dynamic, to examine how teacher--student prefix consistency influences the efficacy of on-policy distillation. Experiments on benchmarks covering Mandarin, Mandarin subdialects, Cantonese, and English demonstrate that LS-MOPD substantially outperforms RL baselines and consistently surpasses the empirical performance envelope defined by best-performing RL teachers, revealing its potential to generalize beyond all teachers in multilingual ASR.
title: Language-Specialized Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Multilingual LLM-Based ASR
title_translated: 面向多语言大模型语音识别的语言专用多教师在线策略蒸馏方法
summary_translated: 现代基于大语言模型（LLM）的语音识别系统已将多语言能力作为标准特性，利用大规模多语言语料和LLM的跨语言知识，在多语言基准测试中取得优异表现。然而，由于不同语言在声学、音系和词汇特征上的异质性，联合建模不可避免地引发优化冲突，削弱各语言的专属性能。为此，本文提出语言专用多教师在线策略蒸馏（LS-MOPD）方法，将语言特定知识获取与多语言能力整合解耦：先通过强化学习（RL）独立优化各语言专用教师，再通过语言路由和标记级多教师蒸馏，将教师专长整合进一个通用型多语言学生模型，从而减少直接的跨语言优化冲突。我们进一步探索了静态与动态两种声学前缀配置，以研究教师-学生前缀一致性对在线蒸馏效果的影响。在涵盖普通话、方言、粤语和英语的多个基准测试上的实验表明，LS-MOPD显著优于RL基线方法，并持续超越最优RL教师所定义的经验性能上限，展现出在多语言语音识别中超越所有教师的泛化潜力。

summary: Byte-level language models are usually argued for on the grounds of robustness, multilingual fairness, and character-level skills. We point to a different, structural advantage: because they read and write bytes, any two of them share an output space, so knowledge transfer between them is exact and independent of how either was originally tokenized. We hypothesize that the two distributions a byte-level model produces, one over the next byte, one over where its patch boundaries fall, can be disentangled and changed almost independently. A model could absorb a teacher's capability while keeping its own boundaries, or change how it places those boundaries while keeping its capabilities. We lay out the two experiments that would settle the hypothesis, alongside preliminary measurements of the properties they rest on. We argue that the community should move toward a byte-level interface as a shared standard: if the hypothesis holds, then once byte-level models are the norm, transferring capabilities and reshaping boundaries between them become cheap and routine, free of the per-model tokenizer that blocks them today.
title: Disentangling Language Modeling and Boundaries
title_translated: 解耦语言建模与边界划分
summary_translated: 字节级语言模型通常被认为具有鲁棒性、多语言公平性和字符级建模能力等优势。本文指出其另一结构优势：由于它们以字节为输入输出单位，任意两个字节级模型共享相同的输出空间，因此知识迁移是精确且独立于原始分词方式的。我们假设，一个字节级模型生成的两个分布——下一个字节的概率分布，以及其块边界位置的分布——可以几乎独立地解耦和调整。一个模型可以在保留自身边界的同时吸收教师的能力，或在保持自身能力的前提下改变边界划分方式。本文提出了两项实验来验证该假设，并提供了支撑这些实验的初步测量结果。我们认为，学术界应推动采用字节级接口作为统一标准：若该假设成立，则一旦字节级模型成为主流，模型间的能力迁移与边界重构将变得廉价且常规，摆脱当前依赖各模型专属分词器的障碍。

summary: Automation of Translation Quality Estimation (QE) has emerged as a widely discussed approach to managing translation quality at scale, and a growing number of tools and technologies have been released in pursuit of this goal. However, the proliferation of new QE systems has not always been accompanied by robust, transparent, and reproducible research and testing. This gap deserves critical scrutiny. This paper examines some fundamental limitations of the QE technology from both theoretical and empirical perspectives, arguing that current QE systems are structurally ill-equipped to serve as reliable standalone tools in real-world translation workflows. The reviewed evidence suggests that QE suffers from a range of interrelated and largely unresolved limitations. Most fundamentally, the evaluation of the quality of translation at the level of isolated segments is problematic because it tends to miss out on cohesion, coherence, and stylistic and rhetorical text features. In addition, empirical research documents several other limitations and flaws, including failure to generalize, systematic biases, overfitting and distribution collapse, performance gaps, error annotation challenges, and data scarcity. These are structural limitations arising from the complexity of human language and translation as a cognitive and communicative act - limitations that more data and better architectures have so far not overcome. Consequently, segment-level QE scores should not be used as a standalone basis for routing, release, or review bypass in production; we argue future work should focus on automating human evaluation grounded in MQM.
title: Looking under the Wrong Lamppost: On the Limitations of Automated Translation Quality Estimation

title_translated: 在错误灯柱下寻找：自动化翻译质量评估的局限性
summary_translated: 自动化翻译质量评估（QE）已成为规模化管理翻译质量的广泛讨论方案，大量工具和技术相继推出。然而，新QE系统的涌现并未伴随充分、透明且可复现的研究与测试。这一差距亟需批判性审视。本文从理论与实证双重角度分析QE技术的根本局限，认为当前QE系统在实际翻译工作流中不具备作为独立可靠工具的结构性能力。现有证据表明，QE面临一系列相互关联且尚未解决的限制：最根本的问题在于，孤立段落级别的质量评估难以捕捉文本的连贯性、一致性、风格与修辞特征。此外，实证研究还揭示了其他缺陷，包括泛化失败、系统性偏见、过拟合与分布坍缩、性能差距、错误标注难题及数据稀缺等问题。这些均源于人类语言与翻译作为认知与交际行为的复杂性，迄今更多数据与更优架构未能克服此类结构性挑战。因此，段落级QE评分不应单独用于生产环境中的路由、发布或跳过审校决策；我们主张未来研究应聚焦于基于MQM框架的自动化人工评估。

summary: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) exhibit fundamentally different behaviors in enhancing multi-task reasoning for large language models (LLMs). Our preliminary experiments revealed a phenomenon: SFT suffers from severe task conflicts under multi-stage training, whereas RL enables stable coexistence across diverse tasks. Empirically, we trace this to the parameter level, observing that RL induces sparse and approximately orthogonal updates across tasks. We provide a theoretical explanation for this mechanism by analyzing multi-task gradient interference. Our results reveal a distinction: interference in SFT is norm-limited, scaling with the absolute gradient magnitude, whereas interference in RL is variance-limited, bounded by the gradient variance induced by advantage normalization and on-policy optimization. This small variance bound yields near-orthogonal optimization directions across tasks. Leveraging this insight, we propose Parallel-RL, a paradigm that decouples multi-task training, significantly improving efficiency and flexibility.
title: SFT Conflicts, RL Coexists: A Theoretical and Empirical Analysis of Multi-Task Learning for LLMs
title_translated: SFT 冲突，RL 共存：大语言模型多任务学习的理论与实证分析
summary_translated: 监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）在提升大语言模型（LLMs）多任务推理能力方面表现出根本不同的行为。初步实验发现：在多阶段训练中，SFT会遭遇严重的任务冲突，而RL则能在多种任务间实现稳定共存。实证分析表明，这一差异源于参数层面：RL在不同任务间诱导稀疏且近似正交的更新。我们通过分析多任务梯度干扰，提供了该机制的理论解释。研究结果揭示：SFT中的干扰受范数限制，随梯度绝对幅值增长；而RL中的干扰受方差限制，由优势归一化和在线策略优化所导致的梯度方差决定。这一微小的方差上限使得任务间的优化方向趋于近似正交。基于此洞察，我们提出Parallel-RL范式，实现多任务训练的解耦，显著提升训练效率与灵活性。

summary: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models without labeled data by updating the policy with pseudo-labels constructed through majority voting. While effective, the reward signal assigned from majority voting is highly sensitive to consensus strength, defined as the frequency of the most common answer within a rollout group. In TTRL, consensus strength plays a dual role: it reflects both the reliability of the pseudo-label and the distribution of advantages. Low consensus can amplify updates from unreliable pseudo-labels through disproportionately large advantages, whereas high consensus reduces reward contrast and ultimately yields vanishing gradients. In this paper, we introduce Hi-TTRL, a test-time reinforcement learning framework that utilizes hints during sampling to regulate rollout consensus strength. Hi-TTRL first estimates consensus strength from a partial rollout group. When the consensus strength falls outside a target interval, it invokes a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) hint sampler. The sampler targets the power-transformed prefix distribution and uses finite-step approximate sampling to generate rollout prefixes as hints. By tuning the power exponent, Hi-TTRL generates hints with a sharpened or flattened power target, steering rollout consensus strength toward the target interval. Experiments on multiple datasets and backbones show that Hi-TTRL consistently improves over standard TTRL, with ablations and consensus-steering analyses validating the effectiveness of adaptive hint-guided consensus regulation.
title: Hi-TTRL: Regulating Consensus with Hints for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
title_translated: Hi-TTRL：通过提示调节测试时强化学习中的共识
summary_translated: 测试时强化学习（TTRL）通过使用多数投票构建的伪标签来更新策略，从而在无需标注数据的情况下提升大语言模型的推理能力。然而，多数投票分配的奖励信号对共识强度（即滚动组中常见答案的频率）极为敏感。在TTRL中，共识强度具有双重作用：它既反映伪标签的可靠性，也体现优势分布。低共识会因不成比例的大优势而放大不可靠伪标签的影响，而高共识则降低奖励对比度，最终导致梯度消失。本文提出Hi-TTRL，一种利用采样过程中的提示来调节滚动共识强度的测试时强化学习框架。Hi-TTRL首先从部分滚动组估计共识强度；当共识强度超出目标区间时，调用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）提示采样器。该采样器针对幂变换前缀分布，采用有限步近似采样生成滚动前缀作为提示。通过调节幂指数，Hi-TTRL可生成锐化或平滑的幂目标提示，引导滚动共识强度趋向目标区间。在多个数据集和骨干模型上的实验表明，Hi-TTRL持续优于标准TTRL，消融实验与共识调控分析验证了自适应提示引导共识调节的有效性。

summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed in multilingual contexts, yet safety alignment and bias evaluation remain overwhelmingly English-centric. We investigate whether social biases generalise across languages by submitting 4,900 symmetric English--Swahili prompt pairs to GPT-5.2 and Gemini 2.5 Flash across nine demographic bias axes, yielding 19,600 completions evaluated for stereotype prevalence, sentiment, refusal behaviour, and cross-lingual semantic similarity. Our findings show that bias transforms rather than transfers: stereotype rates shifted by up to 12 percentage points on specific axes, Gemini's neutral-sentiment rate doubled in Swahili, and GPT-5.2 refused 169 prompts in English and zero in Swahili, consistent with refusal behaviour anchored to English-language surface forms at the behavioural level. Over 55% of prompt pairs produced semantically dissimilar completions across both models. These reinforce the idea that English-only bias audits do not produce adequate coverage for multilingual deployment.
title: Cross-Lingual Bias in Large Language Models: A Comparative Analysis of English and Swahili
title_translated: 大语言模型中的跨语言偏见：英语与斯瓦希里语的比较分析
summary_translated: 大语言模型越来越多地部署于多语言场景，但安全对齐与偏见评估仍主要以英语为中心。我们通过向GPT-5.2和Gemini 2.5 Flash提交4,900对对称的英-斯瓦希里语提示，在九个社会偏见维度上进行测试，共获得19,600次生成结果，评估了刻板印象普遍性、情感倾向、拒绝行为以及跨语言语义相似性。研究发现，偏见并非简单转移而是发生转化：特定维度上的刻板印象率变化高达12个百分点，Gemini在斯瓦希里语中的中性情感率翻倍，而GPT-5.2在英语中拒绝了169个提示但在斯瓦希里语中为零，表明拒绝行为在行为层面锚定于英语表层形式。超过55%的提示对在两个模型中产生了语义不相似的生成结果。这些结果强调，仅基于英语的偏见审计无法充分覆盖多语言部署场景。

summary: Biomedical literature is increasingly mined for knowledge beyond the questions it was written to answer. Because the target concepts are not known in advance, annotators prefer open-ended labels, whose agreement is hard to quantify. We study soft inter-rater reliability for annotators providing unstructured texts for biomedical annotation tasks. Synthetic experiments show that soft reliability can be quantified using a variety of semantic equivalence measures, and that the choice of measure affects failure modes of the estimation. Embeddings are scalable, but limited when differentiating similar but distinct concepts. Large language models are promising, but limited by scalability for estimating agreement by chance. Finally, we suggest measures based on natural language inference as a sensible compromise.
title: Consensus Measures for Unstructured Biomedical Text Annotations
title_translated: 非结构化生物医学文本标注中的共识度量方法
summary_translated: 生物医学文献正被广泛挖掘以获取其原始问题之外的知识。由于目标概念事先未知，标注者更倾向于使用开放式标签，而这类标签的一致性难以量化。我们研究了在提供非结构化文本进行生物医学标注任务时，标注者之间的软一致性（soft inter-rater reliability）。合成实验表明，多种语义等价度量方法可用于量化软一致性，且度量选择会影响估计的失败模式。嵌入方法具有可扩展性，但在区分相似但不同的概念时受限；大语言模型虽具前景，但因可扩展性问题难以有效估算偶然一致性的基准。最后，我们建议采用基于自然语言推理的度量作为合理折衷方案。

summary: Historical language change affects morphology, syntax, semantics, and pragmatics, yet computational studies typically examine these levels with incompatible representations and therefore cannot determine whether they evolve together across languages. We address this problem by asking how the magnitude and direction of change vary across linguistic levels, languages, and historical periods within a single analytical space. We introduce ChronoLens, a framework that combines frozen multilingual language models, feature-aligned crosscoders, and post-hoc linguistic interventions, and apply it to 44.98 million documents and approximately 17.2 billion tokens from five parliamentary traditions spanning 1803--2026. The resulting sparse representations agree substantially more strongly with linguistic statistics than dense embeddings or a pooled sparse autoencoder ($ρ=0.72$ versus $0.29$ and $0.28$), and reveal that morphology, syntax, semantics, and pragmatics generally change by comparable amounts within a language, while languages differ markedly in when, how far, and in which direction they change. These findings show that historical language change is a structured, multidimensional process: similar magnitudes can conceal different trajectories, and meaningful cross-linguistic comparison requires measuring both distance and direction.
title: ChronoLens: Measuring Language Change Across Time, Languages, and Linguistic Levels
title_translated: ChronoLens：跨时间、语言与语言层级的语言变迁测量
summary_translated: 历史语言变迁影响形态、句法、语义和语用等多个层面，但现有计算研究通常使用不兼容的表示方式分析这些层面，因而无法判断它们是否在不同语言间协同演化。我们通过在一个统一分析空间中探究变化幅度与方向如何在语言层级、语言种类及历史时期之间变化，解决这一问题。我们提出ChronoLens框架，结合冻结的多语言语言模型、特征对齐的跨编码器以及事后语言干预机制，并应用于涵盖1803至2026年五个议会传统的4498万份文档和约172亿个词元。所得稀疏表示与语言统计的相关性显著高于密集嵌入或池化稀疏自编码器（ρ=0.72 vs. 0.29 和 0.28），揭示出在同一语言内部，形态、句法、语义和语用通常以相近程度变化，而不同语言在变化的时间、幅度和方向上存在显著差异。这些发现表明，历史语言变迁是一个结构化的多维过程：相似的变化幅度可能掩盖不同的演变轨迹，有意义的跨语言比较需同时测量距离与方向。

summary: Constructed languages (conlangs) are intentionally created human languages with a rich tradition of linguistic creativity. Despite their potential for studying language learning in large language models (LLMs), existing conlangs remain largely underexplored in LLM research. We present ConlangBench, the first large-scale benchmark for evaluating and training LLMs on 21 existing conlangs. We collect over 21M conlang-English parallel sentence pairs (including 430K pairs across the 20 non-Esperanto conlangs) and 321K vocabulary entries. In bidirectional translation experiments, we find that models perform better on a posteriori conlangs, whose vocabularies are derived from natural languages, reflecting the design characteristics of conlangs. Training on ConlangBench also shows that models can learn all eight conlangs for which sufficient parallel corpora are available, while their learning curves vary depending on how the conlangs were created. Our findings suggest that conlangs provide a unique testbed for investigating how LLMs acquire low-resource languages.
title: ConlangBench: Exploring Language Knowledge and Learning in LLMs through Diverse Constructed Languages
title_translated: ConlangBench：通过多样化人造语言探索大语言模型的语言知识与学习能力
summary_translated: 人造语言（conlangs）是人为创造的人类语言，具有丰富的语言创造力传统。尽管其在研究大语言模型（LLMs）语言学习方面具有潜力，但现有研究对人造语言的探索仍十分有限。我们提出ConlangBench，首个大规模基准，用于评估和训练LLMs在21种现有人造语言上的表现。我们收集了超过2100万条人造语言-英语平行句对（包括20种非世界语人造语言的43万对）以及32.1万词汇条目。在双向翻译实验中，我们发现模型在后验型人造语言（其词汇源自自然语言）上表现更好，反映出人造语言的设计特性。训练结果显示，模型能够学习到所有具备足够平行语料的八种人造语言，且学习曲线因人造语言的创建方式而异。研究结果表明，人造语言为探究LLMs如何习得低资源语言提供了独特测试平台。

summary: Vocabulary extension is an efficient way to adapt pretrained large language models (LLMs) to new languages, but the initialization of newly added token embeddings can strongly affect continued pre-training (CPT) efficiency. We present a systematic study of more than 20 initialization strategies for Hindi vocabulary extension in Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B. Our comparison spans vocabulary-averaging baselines; external and learned initialization methods, including FOCUS, top-k semantic retrieval, and residual MLP mappings; subword composition; norm calibration; and input-output asymmetry. We find that subword composition methods outperform both vocabulary averaging and external/learned initialization approaches. Within subword composition, asymmetric variants achieve the lowest observed early validation loss and reveal distinct preferences for input and output embedding initialization. The best observed configuration initializes the input embedding matrix with uniform subword averaging and Hindi-specific norm calibration, and the output language modeling head with character-length-weighted subword averaging. Relative to the standard Mean-all baseline, this full initialization pipeline reaches comparable validation loss with over a 6x reduction in CPT steps and exceeds the baseline's 3,500-step MILU-Hindi accuracy after only 500 steps. Finally, we show that initialization loss and initialization bits-per-byte (Init BPB) are unreliable predictors of downstream convergence, whereas lightweight CPT, as few as 50 steps, provides a cost-effective and reliable signal for selecting the best initialization strategy.
title: Beyond Initialization Loss: A Systematic Study of Token Embedding Initialization Strategies for LLM Vocabulary Extension
title_translated: 超越初始化损失：针对LLM词表扩展的标记嵌入初始化策略系统性研究
summary_translated: 词表扩展是将预训练大语言模型（LLMs）高效适配到新语言的一种方法，但新增标记嵌入的初始化方式会显著影响持续预训练（CPT）效率。我们对Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B模型在印地语词表扩展中超过20种初始化策略进行了系统性研究。比较涵盖了词表平均基线、外部和学习型初始化方法（包括FOCUS、top-k语义检索和残差MLP映射）、子词组合、范数校准以及输入输出不对称性。研究发现，子词组合方法优于词表平均及外部/学习型初始化方法。在子词组合中，非对称变体表现出最低的早期验证损失，并揭示了输入与输出嵌入初始化的不同偏好。最佳配置采用均匀子词平均初始化输入嵌入矩阵并结合印地语特异性范数校准，输出语言建模头则使用按字符长度加权的子词平均。相较于标准Mean-all基线，该完整初始化流程在CPT步数减少6倍以上的情况下达到相当的验证损失，并在仅500步后就超越基线在3,500步时的MILU-Hindi准确率。最后，我们证明初始化损失和初始化比特每字节（Init BPB）无法可靠预测下游收敛，而轻量级CPT（仅50步）可提供一种成本低且可靠的信号，用于选择最优初始化策略。

summary: The adoption of large pre-trained multilingual models for neural machine translation (MNMT) faces a major challenge: excessive memory and computational consumption due to overly large vocabularies and embedding layers. Although existing compression methods like pruning, quantization and knowledge distillation reduce parameter redundancy, they mainly preserve the structure of the original vocabulary, thereby leaving a major source of inefficiency unresolved. We propose in this paper a general optimization framework that combines a vocabulary pruning method with a targeted fine-tuning protocol for MNMT models. We evaluate the proposed framework using three models (M2M100, NLLB-200, mBART-50) on the English-Arabic language pair. Our approach reduces the vocabulary size from over 128,000 to approximately 10,000 tokens, enabling a 60% memory saving without any loss in performance. Results show that optimized multilingual models can match or exceed the performance of dedicated bilingual baselines. In particular, the pruned and fine-tuned M2M100 model achieves a competitive BLEU score of 42.04 (against 44.59 for the OPUS-MTen- ar bilingual model) while it significantly outperforms it on the COMET metric (0.8730 vs 0.7911) revealing superior semantic adequacy and fluency.
title: Efficient Multilingual Neural Machine Translation via Corpus-Driven Vocabulary Pruning: An English-Arabic Case Study
title_translated: 基于语料驱动的词汇剪枝实现高效多语言神经机器翻译：以英阿语言对为例
summary_translated: 在神经机器翻译（MNMT）中采用大规模预训练多语言模型面临的主要挑战是：过大的词表和嵌入层导致内存和计算资源消耗过大。尽管现有压缩方法如剪枝、量化和知识蒸馏能减少参数冗余，但主要保留原始词表结构，未能解决效率瓶颈。本文提出一个通用优化框架，将词汇剪枝方法与针对性微调协议相结合。我们在三个模型（M2M100、NLLB-200、mBART-50）上以英阿语言对进行评估。该方法将词表规模从超过128,000缩减至约10,000个token，实现60%的内存节省且性能无损。结果表明，优化后的多语言模型可达到甚至超越专用双语基线的表现。特别是，剪枝并微调后的M2M100模型取得42.04的BLEU分数（对比OPUS-MTen-ar双语模型的44.59），同时在COMET指标上显著更优（0.8730 vs 0.7911），体现出更强的语义充分性和流畅性。

summary: When a transformer learns an irregular morphological pattern, what has it learned? Our test case is the Spanish \emph{L-shaped morphome}, a complex irregular pattern in which the verb's stem alternates in exactly the first-person singular indicative and all subjunctive forms, and whose membership no phonological, semantic, or syntactic feature predicts. Prior studies have shown that character-level transformers can reproduce this pattern, but that evidence describes what models produce, not what they represent. Probing five architectures, twelve trained models each, under lemma-disjoint cross-validation with controls and surface baselines, we show that the models encode the L-shaped class itself, not just its visible alternations. It is decodable above every surface baseline, survives instances in which every form shows the same stem, and probes trained on alternating instances still classify non-alternating ones. The encoding is localized where the stem choice is made, at the stem-final consonant position of the middle decoder, before the alternant is read. And it is item-specific: which verbs a model learned matters far more than which architecture it is. The models store the morphome as an item-specific lexical abstraction, sufficient to reproduce the pattern but not to generalize it as humans do.
title: Probing Character-level Transformers for the Spanish L-shaped Morphome
title_translated: 探查字符级Transformer对西班牙语L形形态体的建模能力
summary_translated: 当Transformer学习一种不规则形态模式时，它究竟学到了什么？我们的测试案例是西班牙语的	extit{L形形态体}，这是一种复杂的不规则模式：动词词干仅在第一人称单数直陈式和所有虚拟语气形式中交替变化，且其成员无法由任何语音、语义或句法特征预测。先前研究显示字符级Transformer可以复现这一模式，但这些证据仅描述模型生成的结果，而非其内在表征。通过对五种架构、每种十二个训练模型，在词元不重叠交叉验证下设置对照组和表面基线进行探测，我们发现模型编码的是L形类别本身，而不仅仅是其可见的交替现象。该编码在所有表面基线之上可解码，即使在所有形式都显示相同词干的情况下仍能保持，且在交替实例上训练的探测器仍能正确分类非交替实例。该编码定位在中间解码器的词干末尾辅音位置，即在交替成分被读取之前做出词干选择的位置。此外，该编码具有实例特异性：模型所学的具体动词比其架构类型更重要。模型将该形态体存储为一种实例特异性的词汇抽象，足以复现该模式，但无法像人类一样进行泛化。

summary: Multilingual large language models (LLMs) have been shown to perform better on non-English classification tasks when the representations of the given language are more aligned to English within the model. Several cross-lingual alignment (CLA) scores have been proposed for use with LLMs, along with multiple approaches for extracting embeddings from the models. We provide a comparative analysis of 27 CLA score variants, examining how they differ and how well each predicts downstream performance across three tasks. Crucially, while LLMs are widely used for generative tasks such as machine translation, prior work has focused almost exclusively on classification. We therefore investigate whether CLA scores are similarly predictive of translation performance. To enable computing correlations across target languages, we propose a PMI-based translation metric, which is less dependent on the target language and correlates strongly with chrF. We find that CLA with English predicts translation quality comparably to or better than source-target CLA, providing new evidence that LLMs use English as an internal pivot language.
title: Predicting Multilingual Classification and Translation Performance of LLMs with Cross-Lingual Alignment $\unicode{x2013}$ Is English Enough?
title_translated: 通过跨语言对齐预测LLM的多语言分类与翻译性能——英语足够了吗？
summary_translated: 研究表明，当目标语言在模型内部与英语的表示越对齐时，多语言大语言模型（LLMs）在非英语分类任务上的表现越好。已有多种跨语言对齐（CLA）评分方法被提出用于LLMs，并伴随多种从模型中提取嵌入的方法。我们对27种CLA评分变体进行了比较分析，探讨它们之间的差异及其在三项下游任务中的预测能力。关键在于，尽管LLMs广泛用于生成任务如机器翻译，但以往研究几乎完全聚焦于分类任务。因此，我们进一步探究CLA评分是否同样能有效预测翻译性能。为支持跨目标语言的相关性计算，我们提出一种基于PMI的翻译度量方法，该方法对目标语言依赖性较低，且与chrF高度相关。研究发现，以英语为基准的CLA在预测翻译质量方面表现与或优于源-目标CLA，为LLMs使用英语作为内部枢纽语言提供了新的证据。

summary: While human evaluation is the gold standard in many NLP tasks, it suffers from prohibitive costs and poor scalability. When identifying top-performing models, typical evaluation protocols waste effort by exhaustively evaluating all models on the entire benchmark, a safe but inefficient approach. In this work, we formalize multi-model human evaluation as a best-arm identification problem in a multi-armed bandit setup with correlated arms, where pulling an arm corresponds to human-evaluating a model. By sampling adaptively based on the intermediate model rankings obtained on the samples so far, we can focus the annotation budget on the most competitive models. We prove the optimality of the proposed algorithms and show that it improves discrimination between top-performing models. This makes evaluations faster, cheaper and more aligned with large-scale competition evaluation goals.
title: Dynamically Allocating Evaluation Effort for Model Ranking
title_translated: 动态分配评估资源以实现模型排序
summary_translated: 尽管人工评估在许多NLP任务中被视为黄金标准，但其成本高昂且难以扩展。在识别表现最佳模型时，传统评估协议通常对所有模型在整个基准上进行彻底评估，这种安全但低效的方式浪费了大量资源。本文将多模型人工评估形式化为一个多臂赌博机设置下的最佳臂识别问题，其中拉动一个臂对应于人工评估一个模型。通过根据已获得样本的中间模型排名自适应采样，我们可以将标注预算集中于最具竞争力的模型上。我们证明了所提算法的最优性，并展示了其在区分顶级模型方面的改进效果。这使得评估更快、更经济，并更契合大规模竞赛评估的目标。

summary: Accurate Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) is critical for reliable deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet traditional probability-based metrics often fail to capture the model's true epistemic state. While recent mechanistic approaches leverage hidden state dynamics, they typically aggregate residual stream updates, conflating the distinct roles of parametric memory (Feed-Forward Networks) and contextual processing (Attention). We argue that this aggregation obscures fine-grained mechanistic conflicts, such as memory-context misalignment, that are fundamental indicators of uncertainty. To address this, we introduce \textbf{D}ecoupled \textbf{U}pdate \textbf{D}ynamics \textbf{(DUD)}, a framework that explicitly decouples FFN and Attention contributions via noise-induced causal interventions. By quantifying the independent restoration capabilities of each module, we construct a dual-stream dynamic profile that captures the model's internal fragility. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DUD significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both uncertainty estimation and calibration, while exhibiting superior cross-dataset generalization, validating decoupled dynamics as a robust proxy for model faithfulness.
title: DUD: Decoupled Update Dynamics for Reliable Uncertainty Quantification in Large Language Models
title_translated: DUD：用于大语言模型可靠不确定性量化的解耦更新动力学
